*Hi Team Fam Living,*

I hope you are having a wonderful and successful week.

I am reaching out to share some exciting news! We have officially launched our new *Official Web Development Platform — Synapsy Studio,* and to celebrate, we have just rolled out our brand-new collection of premium automotive and luxury layout designs.

For this exclusive launch week, we have unlocked special celebratory pricing for your upholstery brand, *valid only until Monday, August 3rd, 2026:*

*• Launch Standard Package:* 
Now only ~AED 1,500~ AED 999 

*• Launch Premium Package:* 
Now only ~AED 2,500~ AED 1,499

🎁 *Exclusive Launch Bonus:* If you lock in your setup before *August 3rd,* we are including our signature *High-Quality Interactive Conversion Button completely free of charge.* This premium, high-converting feature layout normally carries separate installation and maintenance charges. Once this launch week ends, only our standard basic button template will be available.

Please let me know if you would like to secure this limited slot and explore our new collection link to find the perfect fit for your brand.

Best regards,
Sameer
